prohibitions: No automated scanners. SQLMap, Burp Scanner and Dirb are named, and 'or similar tools' reaches anything that sweeps a target rather than reasons about it — so directory, parameter and endpoint fuzzing is off unless the Challenge description explicitly permits it.

Never brute-force Flags on the platform. This Board lists it beside DDoS as harm to the organisers, not as bad manners. A Flag is derived from what you observe, and a wrong-Flag retry loop is never a fallback.
No Flag hoarding. Submit a Flag as soon as you have it; stockpiling and submitting in bulk near the close is a rules violation here.
Harm nothing. Never delete or modify a flag file, never flood a service or the platform, and attack only the Challenge you were handed — not the scoreboard, not another team.
No help from outside the team. Looking something up is fine; posting Challenge content anywhere public, asking in Discord, or soliciting a hint is not.
One team and one account. Never create an additional account to submit a Flag through.
